findings.title: Shared masker context fallback
findings.detail: MaskUnexpectedErrors() is passed as an instance, so Strawberry 0.323.2 reuses it and overwrites self.execution_context per request; under concurrency the anonymise_error fallback can read another request's query. The primary error.source.body check is set for every value-bearing error on this path (located resolver errors and variable-coercion errors), so no leak path was found. Concurrent interleaving is untested.
findings.fix: Pass MaskUnexpectedErrors as a class/factory (no instance) so each request gets its own context; also clears Strawberry's shared-instance deprecation.

findings.title: Traceback dropped for unexpected faults on this root
findings.detail: For registerNetworkInterest requests, unexpected non-psycopg resolver faults now log only ref, field and class name, with no message or stack. Debuggability only; not a security issue.
findings.fix: If diagnosis needs more, log a stack without the exception message or frame locals, or rely on ref plus local reproduction.
